title: WorkerRegistry stake-source integration
purpose: Replace the provisional future ComputeStake binding boundary in CMP-1.3 with the actual qualified CMP-1.5 worker collateral source while preserving fail-closed admission and historical references.
requirements: the actual ComputeStakeWorkerCollateral420 exposes the canonical WorkerRegistry it serves
ComputeWorkerStake420 accepts only a source with the expected ComputeStake source ID and the same exact WorkerRegistry
source runtime code hash is frozen per source-binding revision
live reads and admission fail closed if source code hash or WorkerRegistry identity drifts
historical stake references freeze source address and source runtime code hash in addition to prior worker/policy/position bindings
real Vault-backed worker collateral controls WorkerRegistry stake-required eligibility
a worker without a live qualifying position fails closed
a real qualifying position may produce an immutable historical stake reference
requestExit on the real ComputeStake position immediately removes the worker from new admission where policy rejects exiting collateral
later live collateral changes do not rewrite historical stake references
validator stake, payer escrow, arbitrary balances and cross-wired WorkerRegistry sources remain invalid substitutes
the WorkerRegistry admission adapter remains read-only with respect to collateral custody, slash, reward and withdrawal authority
security_boundaries: governance source binding cannot bind a marker-compatible source attached to another WorkerRegistry
source code identity is frozen and revalidated before reads or admission
worker identity is taken from the same canonical WorkerRegistry used by the collateral source
worker admission never fabricates stake and never owns collateral custody
historical reference state is immutable while new admission remains live-state dependent
accepted-job historical snapshots remain separate from future live admission changes
CMP-1.5.10 remains owner of ComputeEscrow slash-redistribution integration

milestone.rationale: CMP-1.5.9 closes the cross-phase CMP-1.3 WorkerRegistry to CMP-1.5 ComputeStake integration boundary using the real Vault-backed collateral source.
